skipValidation.description: If true, validation of Pkg content will not be done.

artifactId.description:
The id with which to register the {@link Pkg}. Note that this should be unique. If not specified, the id will
be "{pkg.name}-{pkg.version}".

artifactKind.description: The {@link ArtifactHub.ArtifactKind} to set on the uploaded pkg.

useResolvedDependencies.description: If `true` will set {@link ArtifactHub.Artifact.Pkg#resolvedDependencies} based on {@link Pkg#resolvedVersions}.
